name: multi-blocker
description: Multiple external blockers with unclear ownership. Need to prioritise and develop unblocking strategy.
expected_behavior: Present options: create ownership map, identify critical path, escalate, parallel workarounds. Help prioritise.
scenarios: Ownership is unclear (who to talk to?)
Blockers may have dependencies (some block others)
success_indicators: Multiple blockers acknowledged (Stripe API, Legal, Analytics)
Ownership unclear is stated as a problem
Options include: ownership map, critical path, escalation
Suggestion to prioritise one blocker (not all at once)
